import.title: Update portfolio from screenshots
import.intro: Take a screenshot of your holdings from your broker. It is read on this device, and you review every row before anything is saved.
import.consentBody: The server reads the image instead of your device. The top of the image is blanked and the image is re-encoded on your device first. If a cloud vision service is configured, the image may be sent to it, and free-tier services may use what they receive. We keep only the stock list and delete the screenshot right away.
import.reviewHint: Fix anything that looks wrong. Highlighted rows need your attention.

flags.value_mismatch: Quantity × price does not match the value
flags.currency_changed: Currency differs from what you hold
flags.unit_mismatch: Price unit looks wrong (shekels or agorot?)

import.keepOnly: We keep only the stock list. The screenshot is deleted right away.
import.onDeviceNote: On-device reading is private: the image never leaves your phone or computer. The first time, about 15 MB of reading data is downloaded from this site.
import.expires: This draft is deleted automatically on {time} if you do not confirm it.

error.generic: Could not read the screenshot. Try again.
error.noRows: No holdings were found in this screenshot. Try a clearer or larger one, or use server reading.
error.ocr: Reading failed on this device. Try again or use server reading.
error.type: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
error.rate: Too many uploads. Wait a moment and try again.
error.rateWait: Too many uploads. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
error.confirm: Could not save the import. Try again.
error.badNumber: Some numbers cannot be read. Fix the red fields before saving.
error.serverOcr: The server cannot read screenshots right now. Use "Read on this device" instead.
error.currencyChanged: Some rows are shown in a different currency than the security's own. Check the currency or unit and tick "Currency checked" for each flagged row.
error.unmatched: Some rows are not matched to a security. Pick a symbol for the highlighted rows or remove them.
error.unmatchedHint: Pick a symbol for every highlighted row, or remove the row, to continue.

vanished.title: Not in this screenshot
vanished.hint: You held these before, but they are not in these screenshots. Tell us what happened: still held (keep), sold, or moved out (withdrawal). Nothing is sold unless you choose it.

import.rowErrorsTitle: The server rejected these rows. Fix them and try again.
import.manyFilesHint: You can pick several screenshots of the same list (up to {max}). Cards that appear in two screenshots are counted once.

notes.quantityUncertain: The quantity cannot be read from the screenshot (the value is too small to work it out). Enter it yourself.
notes.quantityRequiredHint: Enter the quantity for the highlighted rows before you confirm.
notes.quantityFractional: Value ÷ price is not a whole number. That can be a fractional share, or a wrong price or value. Check them.
notes.costInferred: Cost was estimated from the broker's P&L % ({pnl}), so it is approximate. Edit it if you know the real cost.
notes.duplicateRemoved: This card was in more than one screenshot. The copy was dropped and it is counted once, not added up.
notes.conflict: This card is in several screenshots with different numbers. The later screenshot was kept; the other one said value {value}, price {price}. Check which is right.
notes.costInferredNoPct: Cost was estimated from the broker's P&L %, so it is approximate. Edit it if you know the real cost.
notes.conflictRequiredHint: Check the numbers of the rows that differ between screenshots and tick "I checked these numbers" before you confirm.
notes.currencyRequiredHint: Check the currency of the highlighted rows and tick "Currency checked" before you confirm.

scope.whole: These screenshots show my whole portfolio
scope.wholeHint: Leave this off if they show only part of it: holdings that are not in the screenshots are then left untouched.
scope.fullActive: Whole portfolio: holdings that are not in the screenshots are listed below, and you choose what happened to each one. Nothing is sold automatically.
scope.partialActive: Part of the portfolio: holdings that are not in the screenshots are left untouched.

new.title: New holdings
new.hint: Not in your portfolio yet. They are added with the quantity shown. Was it bought, or did you deposit or transfer it in?

changed.title: Quantity changed
changed.hint: The quantity differs from what the app had. Tell us what happened: a buy or a sale, or a deposit or withdrawal. A deposit or withdrawal is money moved in or out, not profit or loss.

unchanged.title: Unchanged
unchanged.hint: Same quantity as before (a different price alone changes nothing). Open it to check them.

xray.title: Portfolio X-ray
xray.heatmapHint: Tile size is portfolio weight. Colour and sign show today's change.
xray.rulesIntro: Informational checks of your exposure against a threshold. Nothing here stops or changes anything. You can switch each one off or set your own threshold.
xray.rulesError: Could not load the settings for these checks.

analyze.intro: Look up any ticker or company. You get neutral facts: signals, levels, and how it fits your portfolio and limits.
analyze.searchPlaceholder: For example AMD, TEVA.TA or Teva
analyze.noMatches: No matching security. You can still try the ticker as typed.
analyze.recentNote: Only the symbols are remembered, not results or notes.
analyze.watchNone: Your watchlist is empty. Use the star on a result to add a stock.
analyze.watchNote: Prices here are the last cached ones, not live.
analyze.inWatch: {symbol} is on your watchlist (tap to remove)
analyze.notFoundBody: No security matches "{symbol}". Check the ticker (TASE tickers end with .TA).
analyze.invalidSymbol: That does not look like a ticker.
analyze.priceStale: Not a live price: last close, as of {time}. Levels are not computed from a stale price.
analyze.heldDetail: You own {qty} units, {weight} of the portfolio ({value}).

analyze.formAmount: How much would you put in?

analyze.askLlm: AI-assisted answer from public stock data only

postmortem.title: Portfolio post-mortem
postmortem.intro: A factual look at what happened to your return compared with what you expected. It describes the past; it does not give advice.

postmortem.periodSince: Since I started using the app
postmortem.badRange: Choose a start date that is before the end date.
postmortem.benchmarkNote: S&P 500 and TA-125, weighted by your holdings
postmortem.notEnoughHistory: {remaining} more days of history are needed ({have} of {need} days so far).
postmortem.notEnoughData: There is not enough data for this period.
postmortem.needsExpectationRef: Set an expected return below to see this comparison.
postmortem.reconciles: The listed items add up to the gap.
postmortem.notReconcile: The listed items do not fully add up to the gap. The unexplained part is shown as it is.
postmortem.gapNotEnough: Not enough data for this comparison.
postmortem.notRecordedHint: The app has not captured this, so no figure is shown.
postmortem.expIntro: Enter the return you were aiming for and over how many months. Both are needed. Nothing is filled in for you.
postmortem.expPair: Enter both the return and the months, or clear both.
postmortem.expRange: Return between -100 and 500, months a whole number from 1 to 120.

shots: The picture is read on your phone by default and is not stored.

suggest.title: Suggest new stocks
suggest.intro: Tell me what you have in mind. Nothing is assumed for you. You get neutral candidates to research, ranked from cached scores and checked against your limits.
suggest.fillAll: Fill in every field to continue.
suggest.noPortfolio: You need a portfolio first. Import or add holdings from the main page.
suggest.gateBody: Scores are experimental until a backtest and paper trading validate them. These are neutral candidates to research, not an instruction to trade.
suggest.resultsMeta: {universe} securities checked, from scores cached {time}. Amount {amount}.
suggest.empty: No candidates fit these inputs and your limits. See the skipped list for why.
suggest.sizeLine: About {qty} units, cost {cost} ({pct} of the amount)
suggest.riskLine: Risk to the stop: {risk} ({pct} of the portfolio)
suggest.skippedNote: These were left out, with the reason for each.

skip.excluded_by_user: You asked to leave this one out.
skip.no_score: It has no score yet, so it cannot be ranked.
skip.low_score: Its score is too low to be worth researching right now.
skip.low_confidence: The data behind its score is too thin to rely on.
skip.stale_score: Its score is out of date and is waiting for the next refresh.
skip.volatility_cap: It moves more than your risk level allows.
skip.no_quote: No price is available for it right now.
skip.stale_price: Its price is old (the last close, not live), so entry and stop levels are not computed from it.
skip.no_levels: Entry, stop and take-profit levels could not be computed for it.
skip.min_rr: The possible gain is too small compared with the risk for your risk level.
skip.position_cap: A position of this size would be larger than your single-position limit.
skip.sector_cap: Your portfolio is already near the limit for its sector.
skip.country_cap: Your portfolio is already near the country cap, so adding more would pass your limit.
skip.size_too_small: With this amount, not even one unit fits within your limits.
skip.duplicate_listing: It is the same company as another listing already considered, so it is not counted twice.
skip.ranked_lower: It is a valid candidate but ranks below the ones shown.

serverText.stop_atr: Stop at {mult} x ATR({period}, {timeframe}) below the price ({pct}%).
serverText.stop_beyond_atr: Stop at the {source} {level}, which sits beyond the {mult} x ATR distance so normal noise does not reach it.
serverText.stop_chart_no_atr: Stop at the {source} {level} (no ATR range for this horizon).
serverText.stop_max_loss_only: No chart level or ATR was available, so the stop is your own {max_loss_pct}% max loss per position.
serverText.stop_saved: Kept your saved stop at {level}: a stop is only ever raised, never lowered.
serverText.trailing_moved: Trailing stop {level}: highest high {highest} minus {mult} x ATR ({profile} profile trail); it only moves up.
serverText.trailing_start: Trailing stop starts at the stop {level} and rises as the price makes new highs.
serverText.breakeven: The price is {gain_atr} ATR above your cost {cost} ({profile} profile suggests this from {from_atr} ATR): moving the stop up to your cost means this position can no longer lose money.
serverText.size_fits: The stop and the position size fit your risk limits.
serverText.size_reduce: The stop stays at {stop}; it is not moved closer to fit your limits. To fit them, keep about {keep_pct}% of the current shares ({suggested} of {current}).

ask.title: Ask my portfolio

ask.placeholder: For example: which holdings are my largest?

ask.declined: I can only describe your data, not tell you what to trade.

committee.title: Investment committee
committee.intro: A deeper read on public information: company profile, news, and the risks a skeptical analyst raises, each answered by the CIO. It never gives a verdict, and it cannot move the score by more than a small cap.
committee.runningNote: The committee is reading the public information. This can take a moment.
